description: Polymer mini HTML file defining core Polymer features, including template preparation, content distribution, DOM API extensions, and custom element lifecycle management.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi
classes.description: Extended DOM API providing methods for node manipulation, event handling, and content distribution, with support for Shadow DOM and Shady DOM.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi.ClassList
classes.description: Wrapper for classList property, allowing class manipulation with automatic content distribution updates.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi.EffectiveNodesObserver
classes.description: Observer for effective DOM nodes, tracking changes and notifying listeners, with Shadow DOM support.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi.DistributedNodesObserver
classes.description: Observer for distributed nodes in Shadow DOM, extending EffectiveNodesObserver.

methods.name: _prepTemplate
methods.description: Prepares the template by importing and decorating it, ensuring it is ready for stamping.

methods.name: _stampTemplate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the template content.

methods.name: instanceTemplate
methods.description: Returns a cloned DOM node from the template.

methods.name: attachedCallback
methods.description: Handles element attachment, triggering readiness and distribution.
